seoTitle: Form Label Checker: Inputs Without an Accessible Name
metaDescription: Paste HTML to find inputs, selects and textareas with no label, placeholder-only fields, broken label for links and groups without a legend.
intro: Finds form controls that have no accessible name or a weak one.
why:
A field without a name is unusable with a screen reader and hard for voice control.

The tool computes each control name from label, aria-label and aria-labelledby, flags placeholder-only and title-only names as weak, finds label for values pointing nowhere, duplicate ids, and radio or checkbox groups outside a fieldset.
howTo: Read errors first, then review items.
Add a visible label for each control.
Group related radios with fieldset and legend.
